summary: The current-contract age-band analysis executed five older denominators plus a fixed-exact-age-composition denominator on common preperiod-selected support with covariance-preserving paired inference. The pooled coefficient ranges from -0.1598 against ages 31-40 to -0.0971 against ages 51-65; only the paired 51-65 versus 26-65 change excludes zero under occupation clustering. Fixed-age standardization changes the pooled coefficient by 0.0008 with interval [-0.0011, 0.0027]. Older groups are labeled comparators, not untreated workers.
